ResearchProjectDef.label: person suits
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into draping mechanoids in human leather so hostile settlements will talk to them.\n\nEarly trials were not convincing. Later trials were also not convincing. The project was declared a success after a pirate raider accepted a silver payment from a skin-wrapped lancer, muttered "nice coat," and left.
